_about: William Wallace (1844-1897), Whyte's Professor of Moral Philosophy at Oxford, Hegel's English translator. Not Alfred Russel Wallace or Edgar Wallace. His own books, raw IA OCR: Epicureanism (London: SPCK, 1880), Life of Arthur Schopenhauer (London: Walter Scott, 1890), Prolegomena to the Study of Hegel's Philosophy and especially of his Logic, 2nd ed. revised (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1894) and Lectures and Essays on Natural Theology and Ethics, edited with a biographical introduction by Edward Caird (Clarendon Press, 1898). His Kant (1882) is on philosophical-classics-for-english-readers. His translations of Hegel's Logic and Philosophy of Mind are translations and are not repeated here. US public domain. No uids minted.
